page.overview:
Who is Bregor?

Bregor was an Edain Man of the House of Bëor.

Bregor was the first child and only son of Boromir, and the brother of Andreth and Beril, his sisters. He eventually became the second Lord of Ladros. Bregor was the father of five children: Bregil, his eldest child and first daughter, Hirwen, his second child and second daughter, Bregolas his third child and elder son, Gilwen, his fourth child and third daughter, and Barahir his last child and youngest son.

Bregor was most likely killed during the Dagor Bragollach. The Bow of Bregor became a relic of the First Age and was preserved in Númenor until the Downfall.

The grandchildren of Bregor were: Brandir (son of Arachon) and his sister Beldis through his first daughter Bregil; Beleth and her brothers, Baragund and Belegund through his elder son Bregolas, and Beren One-handed through his younger son Barahir.
